name: FastSurfer
purpose: Takes a T1 full head image and creates a segmentation using FastSurferVINN and surfaces, thickness etc as a FS subject dir using recon-surf.

inputs.statement: --t1: T1 full head input (not bias corrected), requiring an absolute path.
inputs.quote: --t1 <t1_path> T1 full head input (not bias corrected). Requires an

inputs.statement: Optional T2 full head input for HypVINN; must be externally biasfield corrected when called with --no_biasfield.
inputs.quote: *Optional* T2 full head input (must be externally biasfield

inputs.statement: Optional binary lesion mask in the same space as the T1 input; if provided, pipelines are wrapped with LIT lesion inpainting.
inputs.quote: Path to a binary lesion mask in the same space as the T1 input.

inputs.statement: For --surf_only, the segmentation created by FastSurferVINN must already exist.
inputs.quote: --surf_only Run surface pipeline only. The segmentation input has

conditions.statement: The surface pipeline needs a FreeSurfer license file, as does Talairach registration in segmentation (--tal_reg); a segmentation without --tal_reg does not need one.
conditions.quote:
A
segmentation without --tal_reg does not need one.

conditions.statement: --fs_license is required for Docker when running the surface module; for local installs the license is autodetected.
conditions.quote: Required for Docker when running surface module:

conditions.statement: Input images need not be bias corrected; the network was trained with conformed images and non-compliant images are automatically conformed.
conditions.quote: These specifications are checked in the run_prediction.py script and the image is automatically conformed if it does not comply.

conditions.statement: --native_image or --keepgeom is only supported for --seg_only and is not compatible with the surface pipeline.
conditions.quote:
This setting is not
compatible with the surface pipeline and implies

conditions.statement: A GPU makes the segmentation much faster; memory needs depend on voxel size and whether GPU or CPU does the work.
conditions.quote: A GPU makes the segmentation much faster.

steps.statement: Call run_fastsurfer.sh once per T1w MRI image with the subject directory, subject id and T1 path.
steps.quote: run_fastsurfer.sh is called once for each T1w MRI image that is to be processed

steps.statement: The image is checked and automatically conformed if it does not meet the network's conformed-image specifications.
steps.quote: These specifications are checked in the run_prediction.py script and the image is automatically conformed if it does not comply.

steps.statement: Segmentation is performed with FastSurferVINN, equivalent to FreeSurfer aparc.DKTatlas+aseg.mgz.
steps.quote: a segmentation using FastSurferVINN (equivalent to FreeSurfer

steps.statement: Surfaces, thickness etc. are produced as a FS subject dir using recon-surf.
steps.quote: surfaces, thickness etc as a FS subject dir using recon-surf

steps.statement: After the surface module, some initial segmentations and volume estimates are fine-tuned (e.g., surface-based partial volume correction, addition of corpus callosum labels).
steps.quote: some of the initial segmentations and corresponding volume estimates are fine-tuned (e.g., surface-based partial volume correction, addition of corpus callosum labels)

steps.statement: If a lesion mask is provided, LIT inpaints the lesion region, runs the requested modules on the inpainted image, then maps the lesion back into outputs.
steps.quote:
It inpaints the lesion region, runs the requested
FastSurfer modules on the inpainted image, and then maps the lesion back into the resulting outputs.

checks.statement: --viewagg_device auto checks whether there is enough memory to run view aggregation on the GPU.
checks.quote: By default, the program checks if you have enough memory to run the view aggregation on the GPU.

checks.statement: Unless --ignore_fs_version is set, the program checks the FreeSurfer version and terminates if the supported version is not sourced.
checks.quote: Switch on to avoid check for FreeSurfer version.

checks.statement: --qc_snap creates quality control images to simplify the QC process.
For images with tumors or other large lesions, review LIT-modified outputs before downstream use.
checks.quote: review LIT-modified outputs before downstream use.

exceptions.statement: Without --no_cereb, CerebNet runs automatically whenever the segmentation module runs.
exceptions.quote: Unless switched off by the --no_cereb argument, this module is automatically run whenever the segmentation module is run.

exceptions.statement: Without --no_hypothal, HypVINN runs automatically whenever the segmentation module runs.
exceptions.quote: Unless switched off by the --no_hypothal argument, this module is automatically run whenever the segmentation module is run.

exceptions.statement: With --no_biasfield, HypVINN still runs but expects biasfields to be corrected externally.
exceptions.quote: HypVINN does run but expects that biasfields are corrected externally.

exceptions.statement: --no_surfreg skips surface registration, but sphere.reg is needed for cross-subject statistical analysis of thickness maps.
exceptions.quote: sphere.reg will be needed for any cross-subject statistical analysis of thickness maps

exceptions.statement: Renaming an output file can break a later step, since later modules and follow-up tools look for the default names.
exceptions.quote:
Later modules
and follow-up tools look for the default names, so renaming an output can
break a later step.

outputs.statement: aparc.DKTatlas+aseg.deep.mgz contains the cortical and subcortical segmentation based on the DKT atlas.
outputs.quote: which contains the FastSurfer segmentation of cortical and subcortical structures based on the DKT atlas

outputs.statement: aseg+DKT.stats contains summary statistics for the segmented structures.
outputs.quote: which contains summary statistics for these structures

outputs.statement: Primary surface outputs are pial, white, and inflated surface files, thickness overlay files, and cortical parcellation (annotation) files.
outputs.quote: The primary output files are pial, white, and inflated surface files, the thickness overlay files, and the cortical parcellation (annotation) files.

outputs.statement: Cerebellum module adds cerebellum.CerebNet.nii.gz sub-segmentation and cerebellum.CerebNet.stats summary statistics.
outputs.quote: It adds two files, an image with the sub-segmentation of the cerebellum and a text file with summary statistics.

parameters.statement: --vox_size forces processing at a specific voxel size; 'min' (default) derives it from the minimal voxel size in the T1w image.
parameters.quote:
If "min" is specified (default), the voxel size is
read from the size of the minimal voxel size

parameters.statement: --device selects the inference device: auto (default), cpu, cuda, cuda:<device_num>, or mps.
parameters.quote: --device: Select device for neural network segmentation (auto, cpu, cuda, cuda:<device_num>, mps)

parameters.statement: --3T uses the 3T atlas instead of the 1.5T atlas for Talairach registration, giving better eTIV estimates for 3T images.
parameters.quote: use the 3T atlas instead of the 1.5T atlas (which is used if the flag is not provided)

parameters.statement: --batch sets the batch size for inference; default is 1.
